title: A Playwright framework the whole team could extend
claim: Built a framework developers added tests to without asking QA how.
summary: Replaced a brittle, QA-only UI suite with a layered Playwright + TypeScript framework: fixtures, API-seeded test data and role-based locators, so developers wrote tests in their own PRs.
